# TaxExtension.com

> > TaxExtension.com is an IRS-authorized e-file provider enabling individuals and businesses to quickly file tax extensions online in minutes.

TaxExtension.com, operated by InterSearch Tax Solutions, Inc., provides streamlined online filing for federal and state tax extensions across multiple form types. The platform specializes in helping taxpayers meet IRS deadlines through fast, compliant electronic filing.

## Key Topics

- IRS e-file
- Tax Extension Filing
- Form 1040 (Personal)
- Business Tax Forms (1120, 1120-S, 1065)
- Schedule C (Self-Employment)
- Schedule D (Capital Gains)
- Schedule E (Rental Income)
- Form 1040-X (Amendments)
- State Tax Extensions
- Tax Compliance
- Tax Deductions
- Education Tax Credits (Form 8863)
- Retirement Plans (Form 5329)
- Tax Deadline Management
- IRS Approval

## Core Filing Services

- [File An Online IRS Tax Extension](https://www.taxextension.com): Homepage: File IRS tax extensions online for personal/business returns
- [File a Personal Tax Extension Online](https://www.taxextension.com/personal-online-tax-extension): Personal tax extension filing via Form 1040, 1040-SR, 1040-NR with IRS e-file
- [File a Business Tax Extension Online](https://www.taxextension.com/business-online-tax-extension): Business tax extension filing via Form 1120, 1120-S, 1065 with IRS
- [State Tax Extensions](https://www.taxextension.com/state-tax-extensions): Complete guide to state tax extensions across all states
- [Login](https://free.taxextension.com): Login page for TaxExtension.com account access and filing
